scenario.current: getThread and transcript-snapshot in parallel, followed by the required final getThread consistency check
scenario.serialBaseline: the same three HTTP requests awaited in sequence

limitations: The server and database run on the same machine over loopback; this is not a public network or production deployment measurement.
The sample uses an empty Thread and warm SQLite reads, so it does not represent tool-history hydration or a large transcript.
Startup time, model time, SSE streaming and renderer paint time are excluded.
